name: Joshua Tree National Park
tagline: Joshua Tree — desert gardens and rock piles; short loops near the visitor center.
blurb: Desert park day: Joshua trees, rocks, and easy overlooks — heat-smart.
art: Joshua Tree National Park desert with spiky Joshua trees and granite boulders at golden hour

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; timed entry possible peak seasons.
practical.transit_note: Twentynine Palms / Joshua Tree town gateways.
practical.energy_note: Extreme heat in summer — water, shade, early start.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short nature loop → one rock overlook
practical.season_note: Spring/fall best; summer is dangerous heat.

name: Capitol Reef National Park
tagline: Capitol Reef — orchard valley and red cliffs; short scenic drive stops.
blurb: Waterpocket Fold day near Torrey — cliffs, orchards, easy pullouts.
art: Capitol Reef red cliffs and green orchard valley under blue sky

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass for scenic drive areas.
practical.transit_note: Torrey gateway; scenic drive is the main slice.
practical.energy_note: Sun and dry air; little shade on rocks.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Fruita area → one scenic pullout
practical.season_note: Orchard fruit seasons vary; roads can close in storms.

name: Saguaro National Park
tagline: Saguaro — giant cactus forest loops near Tucson; two districts, pick one.
blurb: Desert cactus day — short paved loops among towering saguaros.
art: Sonoran Desert with tall saguaro cacti and purple mountains at sunset

practical.transit_note: Tucson; choose Rincon (east) or Tucson Mountain (west) for one day.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short cactus loop → overlook

name: Olympic National Park
tagline: Olympic — pick one: rainforest, coast, or hurricane ridge — not all three.
blurb: One ecosystem day: rainforest boardwalk or coast or ridge views.
art: Olympic temperate rainforest with mossy trees and soft mist light

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; long drives between zones.
practical.transit_note: Port Angeles hub; distances are huge — one zone only.
practical.best_start: Pick one visitor center zone → short trail or beach
practical.season_note: Hurricane Ridge seasonal; rainforests year-round wet.

name: Redwood National and State Parks
tagline: Redwoods — tall-tree groves and short understory walks.
blurb: Coast redwood day — enormous trunks on short trails.
slice: Prairie Creek / Lady Bird grove-style short walk
art: Coast redwood forest with towering straight trunks and ferns

practical.ticket_note: Partner state parks may have day fees; check NPS.
practical.best_start: Visitor info → short grove trail → one more stop

name: Death Valley National Park
tagline: Death Valley — short cool-season stops only; heat is the limit.
blurb: Cool-season desert day — overlooks and short walks; never midday summer hikes.
art: Death Valley golden badlands and wide desert basin under huge sky

practical.energy_note: HEAT KILLS — winter/spring only for most families; gallons of water.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → one overlook → short badlands path if cool
practical.season_note: Summer often unsafe for outdoor walking.

name: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park
tagline: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes — crater rim and steam vents; conditions change with activity.
blurb: Volcano rim day — steam, craters, and short paved walks when open.
art: Volcanic crater rim with steam vents and black rock under tropical sky

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; check eruption/closure alerts before you go.
practical.transit_note: From Hilo side; Chain of Craters may be long.
practical.energy_note: Sulfur air can bother lungs; stay on marked paths.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → rim walk or steam vents → museum
practical.season_note: Access changes with volcanic activity — verify NPS alerts.

name: Glacier National Park
tagline: Glacier — short valley or lake stops; Going-to-the-Sun is seasonal.
blurb: Mountain lake day — one valley slice, not the whole Going-to-the-Sun epic.
slice: Apgar / Lake McDonald area (or open segment)
art: Glacier National Park turquoise lake and sharp peaks with evergreens

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; vehicle reservations common in peak season.
practical.energy_note: Cold water, bears — food storage rules; altitude mild at lakes.
practical.best_start: Apgar visitor area → lakeshore stroll → one short trail
practical.season_note: Going-to-the-Sun Road seasonal; many services summer-only.

name: Grand Teton National Park
tagline: Grand Teton — mountain backdrop pullouts and Jenny Lake area shorts.
blurb: Teton view day — lakes and pullouts without a full cascade canyon hike.
art: Grand Teton jagged peaks reflecting in a calm blue lake

practical.best_start: Visitor center → lake viewpoint → one short path

name: Badlands National Park
tagline: Badlands — loop road overlooks and a short fossil/boardwalk stop.
blurb: Striped badlands day — pullouts and one easy walk.
art: Badlands striped pink and tan formations under wide prairie sky

practical.transit_note: Interior / Wall gateways; loop road is the slice.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → two overlooks → short boardwalk if open
practical.season_note: Hot summers, cold winters; spring/fall sweet spot.

name: Theodore Roosevelt National Park
tagline: Theodore Roosevelt — South Unit scenic drive and prairie dog towns.
blurb: Badlands prairie day near Medora — wildlife from the car and short stops.
art: North Dakota badlands and prairie with bison in the distance

practical.energy_note: Wind and sun; wildlife distance rules.
practical.best_start: South Unit visitor center → scenic drive pullouts

name: Shenandoah National Park
tagline: Shenandoah — Skyline Drive overlooks and one short waterfall or trail.
blurb: Blue Ridge day — overlooks on Skyline Drive, not a full AT thru-hike.
slice: Skyline Drive segment + one short stop
art: Shenandoah Blue Ridge mountains with layered blue ridges at golden hour

practical.transit_note: Multiple entrances; Skyline Drive is the spine.
practical.best_start: Entrance station → two overlooks → short trail if energy
practical.season_note: Fall color crowds; winter ice on drive.

name: Mammoth Cave National Park
tagline: Mammoth Cave — visitor center and a timed cave tour; surface trails optional.
blurb: Cave day — reserve a tour; surface boardwalks if tickets are full.
art: Cave entrance hillside with forest and a path into a dark limestone mouth

practical.ticket_note: Cave tours often require advance tickets.
practical.energy_note: Cave is cool year-round; stairs on many tours.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → reserved tour → short surface path

name: Indiana Dunes National Park
tagline: Indiana Dunes — lake beach and dune trail near Chicago.
blurb: Great Lakes beach day — dunes and shoreline without a long drive west.
art: Indiana Dunes sandy hills and Lake Michigan blue water with beach grass

practical.ticket_note: Some beach lots have day fees; check NPS.
practical.transit_note: Near Chicago; parking fills summer weekends.
practical.energy_note: Sand is hard work for little legs; sun and wind.

name: Hot Springs National Park
tagline: Hot Springs — Bathhouse Row and a short mountain trail or overlook.
blurb: Town park day — historic bathhouses and an easy hillside walk.
art: Historic bathhouse row with grand old buildings and a green hillside park

practical.ticket_note: Park is free to walk; bathhouse spa experiences cost extra.
practical.transit_note: Downtown Hot Springs is the hub.
practical.best_start: Visitor center on Bathhouse Row → promenade → short trail if energy

name: Congaree National Park
tagline: Congaree — boardwalk through old-growth bottomland forest.
blurb: Floodplain forest day — long boardwalk, big trees, mosquitoes in season.
art: Congaree swamp boardwalk through tall bald cypress and green canopy

practical.transit_note: Near Columbia SC; visitor center start.
practical.energy_note: Bugs and heat in summer; boardwalk is the win.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → boardwalk loop (short or long)
practical.season_note: Flooding can close sections; check conditions.

name: Gateway Arch National Park
tagline: Gateway Arch — riverfront park and arch grounds; tram tickets separate.
blurb: Urban national park hour — arch views, museum, river steps.
art: Gateway Arch silver curve over green park lawn and river city skyline soft background

practical.ticket_note: Grounds free; tram/museum tickets often timed.
practical.energy_note: Easy walking; sun on the lawn.
practical.best_start: Visitor center/museum → arch base views → riverfront
practical.season_note: Year-round; summer hot on open plaza.

name: Petrified Forest National Park
tagline: Petrified Forest — painted desert views and short fossil wood loops.
blurb: Colorful desert day — scenic drive pullouts and easy fossil walks.
art: Petrified Forest painted desert badlands with colorful layered hills

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass; park hours are daytime-only (gates close).
practical.energy_note: Sun and wind; stay on trails (fossils protected).
practical.best_start: North or south entrance → overlooks → short loop
practical.season_note: Gates close at posted hours — don’t get locked in.
